verdict.rationale: Omnara lets users delegate tasks to agents inside its own dashboard: you launch an agent, follow its progress, send corrections and queue its next task. However, each agent must first be defined by the user as a YAML config with an organization-connected model provider, so the evidence shows a platform for building and running user-configured agents rather than a ready-made built-in assistant. Missing for 10: a pre-configured built-in assistant that works without config or model setup, and independent or hands-on corroboration of in-product task delegation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
